# openmetadata_stored_procedure (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata stored procedure inside a database schema. The procedure body and language are patched in place, while its name, parent schema, and type are fixed at creation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_database_service" "warehouse" {
  name         = "warehouse"
  service_type = "Postgres"
}

resource "openmetadata_database" "analytics" {
  name    = "analytics"
  service = openmetadata_database_service.warehouse.name
}

resource "openmetadata_database_schema" "public" {
  name     = "public"
  database = openmetadata_database.analytics.fully_qualified_name
}

resource "openmetadata_stored_procedure" "customer_report" {
  name            = "customer_report"
  database_schema = openmetadata_database_schema.public.fully_qualified_name
  display_name    = "Customer report"
  description     = "Aggregates customer activity for the finance dashboard."
  code            = "BEGIN SELECT 1; END"
  language        = "SQL"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) Stored procedure body.
- `database_schema` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent database schema. Changing it replaces the procedure.
- `name` (String) Stored procedure name. Changing it replaces the procedure, because the name is part of its fully qualified name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the stored procedure.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.
- `language` (String) Language the procedure is written in: External, Java, JavaScript, Python, or SQL.
- `stored_procedure_type` (String) Procedure type: Function, StoredPackage, StoredProcedure, or UDF. The server fixes this at creation, so changing it replaces the procedure.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name, in the form service.database.schema.name.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_stored_procedure.customer_report 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, in the form service.database.schema.procedure.
terraform import openmetadata_stored_procedure.customer_report warehouse.analytics.public.customer_report
```
